snippet.title: Forsaken Lands | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464640/Forsaken_Lands/

Step into a co-op roguelite deckbuilder where courage and strategy define your fate! Unite a team of brave heroes, explore the Forsaken Lands, craft powerful decks, battle strange creatures, and challenge the gods themselves.
